name: Covenant
description: A legal hub with weight: an intro and three cards on how the agreements fit, documents grouped as Agreements, Privacy and Policies, and documents with numbered clauses, a boxed plain-English summary and the register in a sidebar.
features: Preset: cards — each document as a card with its description, grouped under its collection
Intro band with three cards: how the agreements fit, your data, recent changes
Automatic clause numbers (1. / 1.1) written into the headings and the contents rail
Effective date as the kicker above the title and the lead of the head, spelled long
Plain-English summary as a raised callout; definitions as a two-column table
The register beside every document (sidebar) and an on-this-page rail
History disclosure under the head; Get updates as a menu
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

Controller — the party that decides why and how personal data is processed.
Processor — the party that processes personal data on the controller’s behalf.
Breach — a security incident that leads to the loss of, or unauthorized access to, personal data.
